headline: After MSCI – President Speaks, Check 5 Picked Stocks Today
summary: Indonesia's IHSG rose 1.35% to 5,215.85, led by Bank Central Asia (BBCA) and Chandra Asri (TPIA). Foreign investors recorded net selling of Rp750 billion.
why: The Jakarta Composite Index tracks the Indonesia Stock Exchange, the main benchmark for Indonesian equities. Banks such as BBCA carry large weights in the index and are closely watched by foreign investors.
why_moved: The index gain was driven by BBCA and TPIA, according to the report. Foreign investors were net sellers of Rp750 billion, which offset part of the broader buying.
original_headline: Usai MSCI - Presiden Bicara, Simak 5 Saham Pilihan Hari Ini
